import json, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
q = chr(34)
sq = chr(39)
root = Path.cwd().resolve()
real = shutil.which('tmux')
if not real:
    raise SystemExit('tmux is required for the empty pane_dead_status oracle')
td = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='purrfect-dead-status-'))
try:
    bindir = td / 'bin'
    bindir.mkdir()
    ws = td / 'ws'
    ws.mkdir()
    out = td / 'out'
    out.mkdir()
    cli = td / 'ok.sh'
    cli.write_text('#!/bin/sh' + chr(10) + 'echo shim-ok' + chr(10) + 'exit 0' + chr(10), encoding='utf-8')
    cli.chmod(0o755)
    shim = bindir / 'tmux'
    lines = [
        '#!/bin/sh',
        'real=%s' % json.dumps(real),
        'for arg in ' + q + '$@' + q + '; do',
        '  if [ ' + q + '$arg' + q + ' = ' + sq + '#{pane_dead_status}' + sq + ' ]; then',
        '    exit 0',
        '  fi',
        'done',
        'exec ' + q + '$real' + q + ' ' + q + '$@' + q,
    ]
    shim.write_text(chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10), encoding='utf-8')
    shim.chmod(0o755)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env['PATH'] = str(bindir) + os.pathsep + env.get('PATH', '')
    env['DRIVE_CLI_OUT_ROOT'] = str(out)
    env['DRIVE_CLI_STALL_SECS'] = '8'
    env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
    proc = subprocess.run(['bash', str(root / 'scripts' / 'drive-cli.sh'), str(ws), '--', str(cli)], cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
    blob = proc.stdout + proc.stderr
    dirs = [p for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_dir()]
    result = {}
    if len(dirs) == 1:
        rj = dirs[0] / 'result.json'
        if rj.is_file() and rj.stat().st_size:
            try:
                result = json.loads(rj.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                result = {}
    if proc.returncode != 0 or 'Traceback' in blob or 'ValueError' in blob or result.get('exit_code') != 0 or result.get('reason') != 'completed' or 'shim-ok' not in blob:
        raise SystemExit('empty pane_dead_status oracle failed rc=%s result=%r tail=%s' % (proc.returncode, result, blob[-600:]))
    script = (root / 'scripts' / 'drive-cli.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    test = (root / 'tests' / 'test-drive-cli.sh').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for needle in ('normalize_dead_status()', 'internal: non-numeric exit code', '=~ ^[0-9]+$', 're.fullmatch(r' + q + '[0-9]+' + q + ', raw)', '(normalize_dead_status ' + q + '$DEAD_STATUS' + q + ')'):
        if needle not in script:
            raise SystemExit('drive-cli.sh missing ' + needle)
    for needle in ('== empty pane_dead_status from tmux shim exits 0', '== non-numeric pane_dead_status normalises to 0', 'check_norm ' + q + q + ' 0', 'check_norm ' + q + 'nope' + q + ' 0', 'check_norm ' + q + '137' + q + ' 137', 'doc.get(' + q + 'exit_code' + q + ') == 0', 'doc.get(' + q + 'reason' + q + ') == ' + q + 'completed' + q):
        if needle not in test:
            raise SystemExit('test-drive-cli.sh missing ' + needle)
    print('ok')
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(td)
